title: The exact two-dimensional laws: Newman-Moore, Baxter-Wu, and line collapse
claim: On the triangular lattice (up triangles ((i,j),(i+1,j),(i,j+1)), down triangles ((i+1,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j+1)), colour class (i - j) mod 3), with shared subdivision by k as in SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A. Theorem 1 (parity b on up triangles, the Newman-Moore model): solutions on the L-torus are the rows fixed by the L-th power of x -> (1 + S)x + b; for L = 2m the restriction to the coarse sites is onto the coarse solutions with exactly N(m) extensions each and N(2m) = N(m)^2, because (1 + S)^2 = 1 + S^2 over the two-element field; not exact at scale 3 (tori of side 9 and 12); two solutions on the plane differing in finitely many sites are equal. Theorem 2 (parity b on all triangles, Baxter-Wu ground states): opposite vertices of two triangles sharing an edge are equal, so solutions are constant on colour classes (four patterns when 3 divides L, the constant b otherwise); exact at scale 2 with one extension each (2 permutes the classes), not at scale 3; rigid on the plane. Theorem 3 (twisted not-all-equal, the six exact placement pairs, one orbit under the lattice symmetries and complement): walls persist from row to row, so on every torus the solutions are exactly the 2^L configurations constant along one lattice direction; exact at every scale k dividing L with 2^(L - L/k) extensions; no projection onto a triangle is a knot (two of its vertices are equal); not rigid on the plane (half-lines). Proposition 4 (computation): the twelve exact three-excluded pairs have exactly the Baxter-Wu solution sets of one parity on the tori of side 2 to 11, and no patch of radius at most 3 excludes their extra tuple. Corollary 5: every exact rule of ticket A is certified, on the tori of side 2 to 11, to have the solution set of one of these families, and its projection onto a triangle is a knot only in the two parity families.
failure_conditions: A torus of side 2 to 12 on which a family's certified solution set (predicted configurations all satisfying the rule, count equal to the transfer-matrix count) fails.
A Newman-Moore torus of even side up to 12 where restriction is not onto with N(m) extensions, or a scale-3 torus (side 9 or 12) where it is exact.
A Baxter-Wu or line-collapse exactness count different from one, respectively 2^(L - L/k), on the stated tori.
An exact rule of ticket A outside the three families on some torus of side 2 to 11, or a line-constant rule with a triangle projection that is a knot.
foundation_claim_scope: The exact rules of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A (copies of one knot class on the triangular lattice, shared subdivision by 2 and 3). Theorems 1 to 3 hold for every torus and on the plane as stated; Proposition 4 and Corollary 5 are certified on tori of side 2 to 11 only. Nativeness uses the canonical source-aware reading (adopted 2026-10-20).
